title: C# Method Overloading
description: With method overloading, multiple methods can have the same name with different parameters.
example:
static int PlusMethod(int x, int y) { return x + y; }
static double PlusMethod(double x, double y) { return x + y; }

challenges.title: Overload Sum
challenges.exercise: Create two 'Plus' methods. One takes two ints, the other two doubles. Print Plus(5, 5) and Plus(5.5, 5.5).
